notes: Generated names are compounds with indefinite second parts (generatedNames: compound): Åsk + topp = Åsktopp, Järn + port = Järnport.
The Japanese statutory titles expand into Swedish explanations; long page headings wrap.
Nothing attaches to a placeholder: no definite ending or genitive s (By: {name}, byggnaden {building}); tests/locales/swedish.test.ts checks it.
Actual player names, authored chat, technical IDs (IndexedDB, productId, enum values such as delete or reject) and provider-owned sheets are outside automatic translation.
No native Swedish speaker has reviewed this translation yet, nor the legal pages; that review remains a release step.
